metadata.environment: lab/no-trail (moto emulated account, not a live AWS account)
metadata.severity_disclaimer: Severity is this project's internal prioritisation model. It is not a CVSS score, an AWS risk rating, or a formal industry classification.

findings.title: No CloudTrail trail configured
findings.description: DescribeTrails returned no trails for this account and region. Management-event history is therefore not being retained in a durable, tamper-evident form; the console Event history view keeps only 90 days and is not usable as incident evidence.
findings.remediation: Create a multi-region trail with log file validation enabled, delivering to a dedicated log bucket with Block Public Access on.
findings.rationale: Without a trail there is no durable record of management-plane activity. The CloudTrail Event history console view retains only 90 days and cannot be used as tamper-evident evidence, so an incident older than that is uninvestigable.

compliance.framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0
compliance.control_title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
